title: SKE Crystal Gami Rare Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Gami Rare flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid brings the delightful taste of mixed fruit gummy candies to your vape. Each puff is a trip down memory lane with the sweet, chewy flavours of childhood candy favourites, perfectly recreated in vape form. This e-liquid is designed to provide a sweet yet not overpowering candy experience, enhanced with the smoothness of nicotine salts for a satisfying throat hit. It's ideal for vapers who crave sweet, candy-like flavours without the stickiness of actual gummies. The 50VG/50PG blend offers a perfect balance between flavour intensity and vapour production, making it suitable for a variety of MTL vaping devices. Dive into the fun, fruity world of gummy candies with Gami Rare, a must-try for any sweet tooth. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
